business_summary: McDonald's Holdings Company (Japan), Ltd. owns and operates hamburger restaurant chain under the McDonald's brand in Japan. The company was formerly known as Japan McDonald's K.K. and changed its name to McDonald's Holdings Company (Japan), Ltd. in July 2002. McDonald's Holdings Company (Japan), Ltd. was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: McDonald's Holdings Company (일본), Ltd.는 일본에서 McDonald's 브랜드로 햄버거 레스토랑 체인을 소유 및 운영하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Japan McDonald's K.K로 알려졌습니다. 2002년 7월 사명을 McDonald's Holdings Company (일본), Ltd.로 변경했습니다. McDonald's Holdings Company (일본), Ltd.는 1977년에 설립되었으며 일본 도쿄에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
